card.name: Multiple sclerosis drug and type text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or brackets (is, with, or, and, an opening parenthesis) in multiple sclerosis text. They fall right after an MS type or MS drug name, such as progressive MS, beta interferon, or fingolimod.

modes.label: After MS types
modes.description: Linking word right after a form of multiple sclerosis such as progressive MS.

modes.description: The word "or" or a bracket after an MS drug name, leading to another drug or a section reference.
